objects.name: Silent Librarian
objects.description: [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) is a group that has targeted research and proprietary data at universities, government agencies, and private sector companies worldwide since at least 2013. Members of  [Silent Librarian](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0122) are known to have been affiliated with the Iran-based Mabna Institute which has conducted cyber intrusions at the behest of the government of Iran, specifically the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).(Citation: DOJ Iran Indictments March 2018)(Citation: Phish Labs Silent Librarian)(Citation: Malwarebytes Silent Librarian October 2020)

organizations.name: Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC)
organizations.relationship: U.S.-government-alleged beneficiary/client of the Mabna campaign
organizations.analyst_notes: DOJ alleges that Mabna conducted the university spearphishing campaign on behalf of the IRGC and other Iranian clients; Treasury states that the IRGC outsourced intrusions to Mabna. This is not a proven command relationship or an exact-identity assertion between Mabna and Silent Librarian.

x_attribution.assessment: U.S. DOJ charging documents and Treasury's 2018 designation allege that the Iran-based Mabna Institute conducted many intrusions for the IRGC and other Iranian government or university clients. Applied to Silent Librarian only through the separately modeled medium-confidence Mabna association.
x_attribution.analyst_notes: Source-scoped U.S.-government allegation, not an adjudicated finding. Iran/IRGC is not inferred from target geography, language, infrastructure, or residence, and state-aligned does not imply organizational subordination.

x_free_text.executive_summary: Silent Librarianの標準化プロファイル。リポジトリ内の専用資料1件とMITRE ATT&CK、アクターマッピング表を基礎情報としている。
x_free_text.targeting_details: Mabna Instituteの被疑キャンペーンについてDOJが列挙した対象国・分野を、MITRE ATT&CKの構成員affiliationを介したmedium-confidenceの活動範囲として保持する。Silent Librarian全体の直接・高確度ターゲット範囲とは扱わない。DOJの集計は米国144大学、国外178大学、米国企業42社以上、国外企業11社以上、米国の連邦・州政府機関5機関以上、NGO 2団体以上。
x_free_text.additional_notes: 自動構造化した項目はdraftであり、candidateとunknownを分析者がレビューする。
